notes: A007413Proof.A007413_main (A007413_mathlib.lean): for n >= 1, A007413 n = (sig^[n] [1])[n-1] (sig: 1->123, 2->13, 3->2) equals the number of i strictly between the n-th and (n+1)-th 2 of A076826 (= 2 Σ_{k<=n} tm k - n) with A076826 i = 1. Also A007413_iter/len_iter (the iterates agree with u n = 2 + tm n - tm (n+1) and cover every position). Key: sig maps the prefix of u of length m to the prefix of length 2m + tm m (four cases), A076826(2m) = 2 tm m, A076826(2m+1) = 1, and odious numbers are o(j) = 2j + 1 - tm j. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (certificate/check.py checks both b-files and the claim for n < 150000).
